export function getSoftwareByCategory(category: string): Software[] {
	return softwareData.filter(software => software.category === category);
}

export function getFeaturedSoftware(): Software[] {
	return softwareData.filter(software => software.featured);
}

export function searchSoftware(query: string): Software[] {
	const lowercaseQuery = query.toLowerCase();
	return softwareData.filter(software => 
		software.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowercaseQuery) ||
		software.description.toLowerCase().includes(lowercaseQuery) ||
		software.tags.some(tag => tag.toLowerCase().includes(lowercaseQuery)) ||
		software.category.toLowerCase().includes(lowercaseQuery)
	);
}
